featured_reviews.review_text:
5 star reviews by Aditya Singh, Dion C, Garv, Prisha Parekh, Sanvi Abhishek, Khushi are by star batch students.
Reviews by Nilesh Tiwari, Ranjeet Shah, hastaaksharm Sanstha, Hetal Dubla are by college teachers.

The worst decision of my life was to join narayana for 11th and 12th... I'll break all the reasons for this 1 star review
1. Faculty is rude, the teachers are rude... they dont even know how to talk to kids.. Their teachers looks down to struggling kids, say them stuff like "your parents might regret having you".. when you go to ask for books or fees related or whatever they'll always have thise rude tone and attitude. The floor incharge keeps on shouting on kids.

2. Books are never received on time. Kids go to check for weeks yet dont receive the books and those books also have mistakes.

3. After a few months they'll create "Star Batches" that will only have topper students and then they'll discard other kids. They stop caring about other batches all their effort is only for those star batches. Infact half of the 5 star reviews are by those star batches student and others by the teachers themselves like the review by Nilesh Tiwari (chem board teacher).

4. If you take a holiday for just one day, the receptionist, the maths teacher, the chem teacher everyone would call non stop amd harrass just for reason of absence.. Infact when my grandfather passed away and I was absent one saturday on monday Ms.Hansa (chem teacher for JEE) says "why did I even go to his funeral and waste my time, what was my need their?"

5. They dont have pcmb courses. During admission my friend took pcmb (they said they had faculty) and then till the day before bio board exam there were no lecs, she had to study on her own for boards.

6. The account lady doesnt even check if the student's fee is paid. My dad had paid full fees but when my mom went to collect my hall ticket she says 50k is pending, after showing the proof she excuses saying "oh my dad must've done online payment" Im Sorry??? do you not log the payments done by parents no matter the source?.

7. There is no motivation in this whole college. The principal, the teachers keeps on bringing down the motivation and belief of students.. I've seen many kids loose their motivations and start self doubting because of their words.

8. Even if you have a hell of fever or you're dying if the dean has come for a check you cant go home. Infact a girl fainted due and the college didnt even had electrolytes. Another kid had to run and by electrolytes for her with HIS OWN money, the teachers didnt even give him money..

If someone still feels like joining you're stupid as hell to join here. You wont get your desired results, you'll end up self studying all the time with 0 help and with that get tortured by their behaviour.. I dont even want a reply by narayana excusing their actions or asking for my details or whtvr.. THIS IS THE TRUTH.

featured_reviews.name: John Yada
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐☆☆☆☆
Terrible Experience – Needs Major Change

This school seriously needs to fix its environment. The management only seems to care about marks and discipline, not about real education or student well-being. The pressure is nonstop, and the atmosphere feels more toxic than motivating.

One of the biggest problems is the teachers — many of them have no manners at all. Instead of guiding or encouraging students, they often use disrespectful and inappropriate language in class. It’s extremely unprofessional and makes students lose respect for the system. Teachers should be setting an example, not putting students down.

There’s little to no space for creativity or mental health support. Students are treated like robots — just expected to memorize, test, and repeat. The administration needs to realize that education is not just about marks but about respect, learning, and growth.

Until there are major changes in how teachers and staff behave, this school will remain one of the worst experiences for students.

featured_reviews.name: Satish Chaurasiya
featured_reviews.review_text:
👩🏻‍🎓Admission & Eligibility:
Best suited for students with a decent percentage and rank in MHT-CET or JEE.
75% attendance is mandatory.
Students involved in technical activities like projects, hackathons, etc., can get grace attendance.

👩🏻‍💻Technical & Co-curricular Activities:
Plenty of extra technical activities available,
Students can join TEJAS, RAW, and more to showcase their talent at national-level competitions.
Every department has its own students’ association that manages events and activities at the department level.
Numerous extra-curricular activities are provided, though students need to actively search and join them.

🫂Scholarships & Financial Support:
Various scholarships are available for students from different categories.
The college helps students with the education loan process.

🏋🏻‍♀️Sports Facilities:
Sports rooms are open after 3 PM.
Students can also play during free lectures or by bunking (although not encouraged).
Sports include Kabaddi, Badminton, Carrom, Chess, and occasionally Cricket & Football etc. Once a year sports competitions are also organised by the sports committee.

🏭Industrial Exposure:
Each department conducts Industrial Visits as part of the academic curriculum.
Project competitions are organized once a year with minimal entry charges, and participants get meals from the college itself on that day.
Internships are available, but students must personally reach out to industries as their interest.

🤑Placements & Career Support:
Placements starts from 7th to 8th semester until all students are placed.
The Training & Placement Officer (TPO) supports all deserving candidates.
Placement packages depend on skills and experience, not comparable to IITs, but decent opportunities exist.
To be placement-ready:
Do at least two internships.
Focus on aptitude and technical preparation from the third year onward.
For Higher study any assistance, also avilable through college itself.

🏛️Infrastructure & Facilities:
Infrastructure is average but satisfactory.
Air-conditioning is available only for the library, labs, and first-year students, with plans to expand to all batches.
Library is large with a wide range of books.
Canteen food is good quality but expensive.
There is a xerox centre on campus which is cheaper than outside stationery.

🚉Accessibility & Location:
The college is at a walkable distance from Dahisar station.
Students can also reach via bus from Borivali station.
Autorickshaw is available from both station.
Concession on First & Second class tickets till age 25.

🏕️Campus Life & Enjoyment
SFIT offers a balanced environment with fun and academics, lush greenery campus. Accessible lift for all students.
Games, picnics, tours, seminars, DJ nights, annual functions, traditional day and more things.
Of course, also assignments, exams, and academic challenges.

📜Final Recommendation:
SFIT is a good choice for ambitious students who didn’t make it to IITs or NITs.
With hard work, discipline, and cooperation with faculty, you can achieve your goals here.

Check the official website for more details and updates.

I'm from the BE Electrical Department 24-25 batch. I have good experience in SFIT, whatever I have written, it's my personal view based on my experience in engineering college.

featured_reviews.review_text: College has Excellent Infrastructure. They have very good classrooms, faculties are nice and students are supportive & co-operative. The teaching is pretty professional and the teachers try to inculcate great cooperative skills in us even though the college is online & they even share their personal experiences. In terms of Placements, college has very good placement services & we get regular information whenever there is any profile requirements. College also provides study loan facilities for students who unable to pay fees at once. College also conducts picnic so students can enjoy life & have fun and become more friendly with each other & they becomes as a family members. For students who wants to make career in management, ISMT is the best college to enhance the career & fulfill professional dreams.
